item.description: The Catholic Knights' season came to a close as they fell to Good Hope 61-45 in the AHSAA 4A Girls Semi-Finals.

item.title: Highland Avenue Elementary Students Celebrate Read Across America Week With Special Guest Readers
item.description: At Highland Avenue Elementary, Principal Muhammad and Librarian Bowman invited families, community leaders and volunteers to read with students throughout the week.

item.title: U.S. Coast Guard chooses campus of former Birmingham-Southern College for new training center
item.description: The campus of the former Birmingham-Southern College will get new life as a training center for the U.S. Coast Guard.

item.title: Park Crossing looks to defend their state title against Hazel Green
item.description: The Thunderbirds are headed back to the AHSAA 6A Girls State Championship Game, where they will take on Hazel Green.

item.title: Fight at Coastal Carolina, South Alabama women’s Sun Belt game injures ref, results in 8 ejections
item.description: A brawl between South Alabama and Coastal Carolina in the Sun Belt Tournament left eight players ejected and knocked a referee to the floor.

item.title: Atlanta Braves’ Jurickson Profar suspended for 2026 season following second positive drug test
item.description: Atlanta Braves outfielder Jurickson Profar has been suspended for the 2026 season by Major League Baseball following his second positive test for a performance-enhancing drug. Profar tested positive for exogenous testosterone and its metabolites, the commissioner’s office said, which means testosterone that was not produced by his body. Because it was a second offense, the length of Profar’s suspension was 162 games.

item.title: Khady Leye sinks winning layup in Auburn women’s 50-49 win over Texas A&M
item.description: Khady Leye scored the winning layup for Auburn with 5 seconds left in a 50-49 win over Texas A&M in the first round of the SEC Tournament.

item.title: Austin scores 14 in 4th quarter, Alabama women beat Missouri 65-48 at SEC Tournament
item.description: Ace Austin scored all of her 14 points in the fourth quarter and Alabama beat Missouri 65-48 in the first round of the SEC Tournament and extend the Tigers’ skid. Alabama (22-9), which had lost back-to-back games and five of six, won its first conference tournament game since 2022.
